adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler, credential creation is implemented as `findFirst` (by `userId` + `appId`) followed by either `update` or `create`. This check-then-act sequence is not atomic, so two concurrent webhook requests for the same `(userId, appSlug/appId)` can both observe “no credential” and both execute `prisma.credential.create(...)`, potentially creating duplicates (or throwing a unique-constraint error if one exists, which is also unhandled).
